context.notes: Plastering the upper storey from timber scaffolding.

result.summary: Critical safety violations observed on high-level plastering work. Workers are using non-standard bamboo/pole scaffolding at heights exceeding 4 meters without fall protection, proper platform decking, guardrails, or hard hats.

ppe.notes: No personal protective equipment (hard hats, safety harnesses, high-vis vests, or safety footwear) is visible on any worker.

findings.description: Multiple workers are working at height on upper scaffold tiers and roof edges with no fall arrest gear, lifelines, or guardrails, posing an extreme fall risk.
findings.location_in_image: Upper scaffold tier and roof parapet level across the facade
findings.corrective_action: Halt work at height immediately. Provide personal fall arrest systems (harnesses, shock-absorbing lanyards, secure anchor points) and install perimeter guardrails.

findings.description: The bamboo pole scaffold structure is unengineered, lacks continuous solid working platforms, guardrails, midrails, and proper structural bracing.
findings.location_in_image: Entire scaffold frame across the building facade
findings.corrective_action: Dismantle or replace with an engineered modular steel scaffolding system featuring fully planked decks, toe-boards, and rigid bracing.

findings.description: Absence of head protection exposes ground and elevated workers to overhead falling debris (tools, plaster material).
findings.corrective_action: Mandate and enforce hard hats, high-visibility vests, and safety boots for all site personnel.

findings.description: Access ladder resting against bamboo framing appears untied at the top and lacks 1-meter extension above the landing platform.
findings.corrective_action: Securely tie off top of ladder, ensure proper 4:1 incline angle, and extend side rails 1 meter above working level.

immediate_actions: Order an immediate stop-work for all tasks performed on the bamboo scaffold.
Safe evacuation of all workers from elevated levels.
Equip all site personnel with mandatory PPE including hard hats, fall protection harnesses, and safety boots.
Erect a compliant engineered scaffolding system with solid working platforms and guardrails prior to resuming work.
result.image_quality_note: Clear full view of facade showing scaffold structure and worker activities.
